metadata.dayModel: civil day [00:00,24:00): current and preceding service calendars; entire intersecting journeys retained, including calls before/after midnight

transformation.method: swisstopo approximate LV95 to WGS84 polynomial; metre-level accuracy; seven decimal places; no simplification; polygon holes and multipart boundaries retained

crosswalk.method: Exact source GO + mode + line overrides. All other joins require literal GO_NR = GTFS agency_id and identical line/mode. An identity match only supplies candidate geometry; every directed stop pattern still has to pass the matcher. GTFS direction_id is never equated to RICHTUNG.

mappings.evidence: AGIS record 350 names Aargau Verkehr AG and Wohlen–Bremgarten–Dietikon. The pinned GTFS publishes this AVA S17 corridor under agency 31; agency 96 publishes S14. Scope is S17 only.

AGIS records 306–307 use tariff publisher Zürcher Verkehrsverbund, not an operating agency. Pinned GTFS route 96-182-1-j26-1 publishes PostAuto 205; ordered stops must match the Bonstetten-Wettswil–Islisberg–Arni corridor.
AGIS records 308–309 use Zürcher Verkehrsverbund. Pinned GTFS route 96-182-3-j26-1 publishes PostAuto 215; ordered stops must match Zürich Wiedikon–Birmensdorf–Oberlunkhofen–Affoltern.
AGIS records 310–311 use Zürcher Verkehrsverbund. Pinned GTFS route 96-173-2-j26-1 publishes PostAuto 245; ordered stops must match Muri–Oberlunkhofen–Birmensdorf.

AGIS records 12–13 name Südbadenbus and the Rheinfelden DE–CH–Regionalspital branch. GTFS route 92-731-2-j26-1 uses Südbadenbus agency sbg034 and unsuffixed 7312. Branch selection remains pattern-specific.
AGIS records 14–15 name Südbadenbus and the Rheinfelden DE–CH–HPS branch. GTFS route 92-731-2-j26-1 uses Südbadenbus agency sbg034 and unsuffixed 7312. Branch selection remains pattern-specific.

sourceVerification.method: Independent Python csv/zip calendar and exception expansion across all national routes. Exact full source platform coordinates, names, identity, ordered calls, boarding rules and shifted times; selected and preceding service dates; missing and unexpected journey set equality. Membership uses the pinned canton stop inventory.

scope: All national GTFS route records. Canton membership requires at least one scheduled call inside the complete Aargau polygon on any archived trip, independent of operator or selected dates. Each daily feed retains only trips that themselves call in Aargau, with their entire stop chain. Non-stopping through traffic and services absent from this GTFS are outside the timetable denominator.

coverageDefinitions.occurrence: Every adjacent stop pair in every retained complete journey, including calls outside the civil window and outside Aargau; not a count of live observations.
coverageDefinitions.cantonAdjacent: An occurrence with at least one endpoint inside the canton polygon. This is not a clipped path-length coverage measure.
coverageDefinitions.directedPattern: Exact GTFS route_id, direction_id and complete ordered platform-ID chain. A full match requires every segment; partial patterns retain all rejected segments.
coverageDefinitions.directedPair: Exact route_id, from platform and to platform; fully matched only if all occurrences across all patterns match.
coverageDefinitions.direction: Monotone projection on one source feature part, either coordinate orientation, at most one lap of an exactly closed part. RICHTUNG is retained, never equated to direction_id. This is ordered-path validation, not certified lane or track direction.

nightService.definition: N/SN line prefix or GTFS night-bus type 705
